title: TGSRTC Employees Protest in Khammam Following Conductor's Death
seoTitle: Khammam TGSRTC employees protest conductor death

tea.why: TGSRTC transport employees protested following the death of a conductor who succumbed to injuries after being pushed from a moving bus.
tea.want: Protesters demanded stringent punishment for the accused and improved safety measures for drivers and conductors.
tea.changed: Nov 4: TGSRTC employees in Khammam boycotted duties and staged demonstrations wearing black badges, resuming services by afternoon.

summary: Following the death of a 24-year-old Telangana State Road Transport Corporation conductor who succumbed to injuries after being pushed from a moving bus during a dispute over change, transport employees across the erstwhile Khammam district launched protests. Organised under the aegis of the TGSRTC Khammam Region JAC, drivers and conductors boycotted duties and staged demonstrations wearing black badges on Wednesday. The protest disrupted bus services across seven depots until Wednesday afternoon. Workers demanded strict legal action against the accused and better safety measures for transport staff. In response, Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar and TGSRTC Managing Director visited the hospital mortuary, and the government announced a job for the victim's mother, a house, and ex-gratia compensation. Police altered the initial attempt-to-murder case to a murder charge following the death.
demands: Foolproof safety measures for drivers and conductors
response: Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar and TGSRTC Managing Director visited the mortuary to pay respects and announced a job for the victim's mother, an Indiramma house, and an ex-gratia compensation of Rs. 10 lakh jointly from the government and RTC, plus Rs. 1 crore in accident insurance.
